Dear MobileFirst Team,

I am writing to you regarding the Senior Flutter Developer role. As a developer with extensive experience in both mobile and backend systems, I have spent the last few years mastering Flutter and Dart. I have built and scaled several high-traffic applications using Firebase and complex state management patterns. My 20+ years in the industry give me a unique perspective on architecture and maintainability. I am highly interested in your remote-first culture and the opportunity to contribute to your global projects. I'd love to share more about my previous work and how I can help your mobile initiatives.

Best regards,
